articles.title: Brazil's startup mission comes to Web Summit Lisbon

points.text: ApexBrasil and Sebrae run a joint mission to Lisbon
points.quote: Brazil's trade and investment agency, ApexBrasil, and Sebrae, its small business service, run a joint mission to Web Summit Lisbon, from 8 to 13 November (9 to 13 for most of the delegation).

points.text: National selection of 100 startups; Sebrae helps top 40
points.quote: Its national selection is 100 startups. Sebrae pays flights and travel insurance for one person from each of the top 40, if they qualify.

points.text: About 200 companies, says ApexBrasil; Sebrae expected 300
points.quote: ApexBrasil says about 200 Brazilian companies take part, around a 324 square metre pavilion in the MEO Arena. In September Sebrae expected about 300 startups in the delegation it leads.

points.text: Training, meeting rooms, investor meetings and follow-up
points.quote: The mission offers training before the trip, meeting rooms in the Brazil Pavilion, investor meetings and follow-up after the summit.

schedule.what: Closing session on putting learning into practice

articles.kind_note: designer: the article says the counts disagree (100, about 200, about 300), so no single count is drawn

articles.title: Europe in Pavilion 4: the Commission's week at Web Summit

figure.label: The Commission's digital department in Lisbon
figure.quote: The Commission's digital department, DG CONNECT, will be in Lisbon from 10 to 12 November, it says.

points.text: Henna Virkkunen on Centre Stage, 10 November
points.quote: Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen speaks on Centre Stage on 10 November, on Europe's tech sovereignty.

points.text: Sessions on AI, data spaces, funding, supercomputing
points.quote: Sessions cover EU help for AI businesses, data spaces, EU funding, IP-backed finance and free supercomputing.

points.text: DG GROW (E415), HaDEA (E418), EuroHPC (E405)
points.quote: DG GROW (E415) and HaDEA (E418) are in Pavilion 4; EuroHPC is at stand E405.

points.text: The Netherlands brings a national delegation
points.quote: The Netherlands brings a national delegation, with its Ministry of Foreign Affairs and its embassy in Lisbon.

schedule.what: DG CONNECT masterclass on data spaces
EUIPO and INPI meetup on IP

articles.title: Following robotics at Web Summit: from the lineup to Técnico's stand

figure.label: of Web Summit's listed speakers are robots
figure.quote: Two of the speakers it lists are robots: AGIBOT's humanoid Agibot A3 and Galbot's G1.

points.text: Two listed speakers are robots: Agibot A3, Galbot G1
points.quote: Web Summit says 800 speakers come to Lisbon, "from AI to robotics". Two of the speakers it lists are robots: AGIBOT's humanoid Agibot A3 and Galbot's G1.

points.text: Unitree co-founder Li Chen is on the list
points.quote: Li Chen, a co-founder of the Chinese robot maker Unitree, is also on the speaker list.

points.text: Técnico shows Unitree robots at stand E272
points.quote: On the floor, Técnico, the University of Lisbon's engineering school, shows robots at its stand in Pavilion 2 (E272) from 10 to 12 November, among them a Unitree humanoid and a Unitree quadruped.

points.text: The stage to stand link is our suggestion
points.quote: The link between the stage and the stand is our suggestion for visitors. No source says the speakers and Técnico plan to meet.

articles.title: Gender in Tech report: 84% see women in leadership

figure.label: report women in leadership at their company
figure.quote: 84% of respondents report women in leadership at their company.

points.text: 84% see women in leadership; 35% at C-suite
points.quote: 84% of respondents report women in leadership at their company, and 35% say women are represented at C-suite level.

points.text: Half experience sexism; 58% say pay is unfair
points.quote: The old barriers remain: half still experience sexism, and 58% say they are not paid fairly compared with men.

points.text: 42% considered stepping back; 52% aged 35 to 44
points.quote: 42% have considered cutting their hours, stepping back from leadership or leaving tech. Among women aged 35 to 44, it is 52%.

points.text: 75% hoped AI would help; 31% say it has
points.quote: Hope in AI has cooled: last year 75% believed AI could help make tech more equal; this year 31% say it has.

schedule.what: Seventh Gender in Tech report published

articles.title: Lisbon's universities at Web Summit: two stands and a pitch day

figure.label: Portuguese universities at the UniVerse pitch day
figure.quote: On 10 November ULisboa hosts the second UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora, with a pitch competition for startups from nine Portuguese universities.

points.text: ULisboa stand in Pavilion 1, 10 to 12 November
points.quote: The University of Lisbon (ULisboa) has a stand in Pavilion 1 from 10 to 12 November, its second Web Summit in a row, with projects from its faculties and its incubator.

points.text: Técnico's stand E272: robots, VR dive, six spin-offs
points.quote: Técnico, ULisboa's engineering school, has its own stand in Pavilion 2 (E272), with robots, a virtual reality dive and six spin-offs: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.

points.text: UniVerse pitch day for nine universities, 10 November
points.quote: On 10 November ULisboa hosts the second UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora, with a pitch competition for startups from nine Portuguese universities.

points.text: ULisboa says four of six unicorns came from it
points.quote: ULisboa says it ranked first in Startup Portugal's 2025 ranking of entrepreneurial universities, and that four of Portugal's six unicorns came from its ecosystem.

articles.title: Road 2 Web Summit: Portugal's startups head for Lisbon

figure.label: Portuguese companies to be selected
figure.quote: Up to 125 Portuguese companies are to be selected.

points.text: Eleventh edition selects up to 125 Portuguese startups
points.quote: Road 2 Web Summit, run by [Startup Portugal](../companies/startup-portugal/index.html) and Web Summit, is in its eleventh edition and selects up to 125 Portuguese startups for this year's summit.

points.text: Bootcamp, 50% off packages, space on Portugal's stand
points.quote: The selected startups get a bootcamp in Porto and Lisbon, 50% off Web Summit's ALPHA or BETA startup packages and extra exhibition space on Portugal's stand.

points.text: Galp prizes: 15,000 euros and 5,000 euros
points.quote: Galp sponsors two prizes: 15,000 euros for the Most Promising Startup and 5,000 euros for the Best Performing Startup.

points.text: Winner announced 12 November, 12:30, Stage 2
points.quote: The 2026 winner is announced at a press conference on Thursday 12 November, at 12:30 on Stage 2.

articles.title: Tuesday 10 November: Europe on stage, universities pitching, first-timers meeting

figure.label: events stand out on Tuesday
figure.quote: On Tuesday the 10th, three events stand out.

points.text: Three Tuesday picks: policy, pitch day, first-timers meetup
points.quote: Three things on Tuesday 10 November suit different people: Europe's tech policy on Centre Stage, a pitch day for university startups, and a meetup for first-timers.

points.text: Virkkunen fireside chat, Centre Stage, 11:05 to 11:25
points.quote: Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen has a fireside chat, "Has Europe's tech moment arrived?", on Centre Stage from 11:05 to 11:25, the Commission says. A Commission masterclass on data spaces follows at 12:00.

points.text: First-timers meetup 11:00 to 11:55 overlaps the chat
points.quote: Web Summit lists a "First timers at Web Summit meetup" from 11:00 to 11:55 in Meetup 4. It overlaps the fireside chat, so a newcomer has to pick one.

points.text: UniVerse pitch day for nine Portuguese universities
points.quote: The University of Lisbon hosts UniVerse: Academia Empreendedora, with a pitch competition for startups from nine Portuguese universities. Its stand (Pavilion 1) and Técnico's (Pavilion 2, E272) open the same day.

articles.title: Web Summit 2026 in numbers: 70,000 people, 10,000 startups

figure.label: attendees expected in Lisbon
figure.quote: Web Summit expects more than 70,000 attendees from more than 100 countries in Lisbon, from 9 to 12 November, including 10,000 startups.

points.text: Over 70,000 attendees expected, including 10,000 startups
points.quote: Web Summit expects more than 70,000 attendees from more than 100 countries in Lisbon, from 9 to 12 November, including 10,000 startups.

points.text: 800 speakers and 17 content tracks
points.quote: It lists 800 speakers and 17 content tracks over four days, from AI and cybersecurity to health, energy and sport.

points.text: 2025: over 22,000 applied, about 2,700 got in
points.quote: The startup programme is selective: in 2025, over 22,000 startups applied and about 2,700 got in, according to Web Summit.

points.text: AI sharpens thinking (55%), adds workload (60%)
points.quote: Its first State of the Industry survey, of 1,455 people in its community, found most think AI sharpens their thinking (55%) but adds to their workload (60%).
